document.about: Owens Corning ProCat professional insulation system accessory list (9 pages). The cover sets a four-line right-aligned 28 pt title with a 5.7 pt raised ® after PROCAT, and the last page closes on a bold contact line above the order table.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#122): a line ending in a web address, a domain, an e-mail address or a phone number was a heading when set bold or large.
